curated.title: journal-file: refuse hash chains and field lists that loop back
curated.note: A single flipped bit in a data object's next_hash_offset made journalctl --verify spin forever instead of reporting corruption, and field and data lists could loop the same way. Offsets that point backward are now refused as invalid.

curated.title: Find a recording's other URIs from an index instead of every saved song
curated.note: Checking whether another URI of a liked recording was saved walked every saved song, for every track on every page. It now asks the recording's own few URIs: a 50-track page after 20k likes drops from 46.7 ms to 0.04 ms.

curated.title: Load Liked Songs a page at a time instead of rebuilding it per page
curated.note: Loading Liked Songs cloned, compared and rebuilt the whole list for every 50-song page. Pages that land at the end are now appended, taking 20,000 songs from 3.95 s to 0.44 s.

curated.title: Median, Dust & Scratches: run time grows linearly with the radius, identical output at 8, 16 and 32-bit (#498)
curated.note: Median and Dust & Scratches gathered a whole disc of samples per pixel, so each doubling of the radius cost 4x. A rank histogram sliding over each tile makes it linear: radius 32 on 1920x1280 drops from 48 s to 0.84 s, bit-identical.

curated.title: Motion Blur: 6x to 70x faster (one merged kernel applied over whole rows)
curated.note: Motion Blur took an edge-checked bilinear sample per step for every pixel. One merged kernel now runs over whole rows: 6x to 71x faster, with at most one 8-bit level of difference.

curated.title: lib: (strutils.c) compute fractional sizes exactly in ul_parse_size()
curated.note: Fractional sizes were summed digit by digit with truncating division, so fallocate -l 1.7G made a 2 GiB file, and a fraction like .10 was off by 10x. The fraction is now computed exactly.

curated.title: systemctl: make list-dependencies --all over 100x faster
curated.note: Tree mode asked PID 1 about the same unit again for every path that reached it. Caching each answer per unit takes systemctl list-dependencies --all from 63.6 s to 0.34 s, byte-for-byte identical output.

curated.title: document.pixel: no panic at x or y = i32::MAX, and no wrap-around past it
curated.note: document.pixel panicked at x or y = i32::MAX, and coordinates past 32 bits silently wrapped to column 0. Out-of-range coordinates are now an error and the edge pixel reads as transparent.

curated.title: Surface Blur: 13x to 40x+ faster on 8-bit layers (sliding histogram)
curated.note: Surface Blur summed the full window for every pixel, over a minute at radius 100. On 8-bit layers a sliding 256-bin histogram does it in O(radius): 13x to about 150x faster.

curated.title: Minimum / Maximum (Squareness): up to 37x faster at large radii, bit-identical output
curated.note: Minimum and Maximum with Squareness scanned every sample in the window per pixel. Reusing the constant-time running extreme from Roundness makes it up to 37x faster at large radii, bit-identical.

curated.title: Box Blur: up to 26x faster at large radii (same running-sum boxes as Gaussian Blur)
curated.note: Box Blur convolved a 2r+1 kernel per pixel, so cost grew with the radius. It now shares Gaussian Blur's running-sum passes: 26x faster at radius 400.

curated.title: Content-Aware Scale: 13x faster seam removal, bit-identical output (part of #211)
curated.note: Every removed seam recomputed the full energy map and copied the whole image. Recomputing only the pixels beside the seam and shifting rows in place takes a seam from 319 ms to 23.6 ms, output unchanged.

curated.title: Paste: a copied image file pastes its pixels (part of #338)
curated.note: Copying an image file in a file manager and pressing Ctrl+V did nothing, because only the path is on the clipboard. Paste now falls back to decoding the first image in the copied file list.

curated.title: Content-Aware Scale: enlarging a 1 px wide or tall layer no longer panics
curated.note: Enlarging a 1 px wide or tall layer in Content-Aware Scale panicked, because the seam loop gave up at width 1. A one-line guard fix lets that last column be duplicated.

curated.title: cal: do not span before year 1 and fix month 0 in --span
curated.note: cal -3 1 1 started at December 0000, and a span beginning exactly 12 months back read full_month[-1] and printed (null). One month index, clamped to January of year 1, fixes both.

curated.title: report: make report-files listing and lookup agree on masked entries
curated.note: report-files listed and looked up entries by different rules, so masking a vendor file with a /dev/null symlink dropped entries and logged warnings. The listing now filters masked entries and the lookup skips non-regular ones the same way.

curated.title: setpriv: match Landlock fs rights exactly
curated.note: setpriv accepted any prefix of a Landlock filesystem right, so a typo like fs:remove quietly gave a weaker sandbox than the one asked for. Now rejected.

curated.title: siphash24: force inlining of the round
curated.note: Forced SipHash's round inline where gcc -O2 declined, making short-key hashing up to 6.6x faster across systemd's hashmaps.

curated.title: journalctl: make the read path 1.7x to 2.5x faster
curated.note: Three fixes on journalctl's per-entry read path, including a UTF-8 decoder that ran twice per byte. Output is byte-for-byte identical, 1.7x to 2.5x faster.

curated.title: utf8,format-table: make the console width helpers agree with the UTF-8 validators
curated.note: The console-width helper used the permissive UTF-8 decoder, so one invalid cell failed a whole table with a bogus out-of-memory error.

curated.title: mbsalign: skip whole CSI sequences when counting cells
curated.note: column(1) mis-measured cells after any non-SGR escape sequence; the scan now stops at a real ECMA-48 CSI final byte.

curated.title: parse-util: fix ineffective overflow guards in store_loadavg_fixed_point()
curated.note: Fixed both overflow guards in the load-average parser: one was inverted and one ran after the shift, so values from 2^53 up wrapped to 0.00 instead of being rejected.

curated.title: resolved: don't disable the listening socket when a datagram is dropped
curated.note: One datagram with a bad checksum, sendable by anyone on the link, disabled resolved's mDNS, LLMNR or stub listener until restart.

curated.title: resolve: fix use-after-free of the service browser in mDNS maintenance
curated.note: A leaked reference let resolved free an mDNS service browser while its maintenance timer still used it: a use-after-free, fixed in one line.

curated.title: compress: fix unbounded buffer growth on truncated streams, and fuzz the decompressors
curated.note: Stopped unbounded buffer growth on truncated compressed streams, and added fuzzers that feed hostile input to every decompressor and to importd's qcow2 path.

curated.title: proxmoxve: Emit one nameserver= karg per address
curated.note: ProxmoxVE configs with more than one nameserver left DNS unset at boot; now emits one dracut nameserver= per address, IPv6 bracketed.

curated.title: providers: Don't panic truncating a multi-byte hostname
curated.note: Truncating a long multi-byte hostname split a UTF-8 character and panicked, failing afterburn-hostname.service at boot.

curated.title: feat(proxy): serve Anthropic-native /v1/models for Claude Code gateway discovery
curated.note: Re-landed Anthropic-native /v1/models after a staging revert, so Claude Code's model picker populates through a litellm gateway.

curated.title: strv: treat newlines as hard line breaks in strv_rebreak_lines()
curated.note: The line re-breaker dropped text before an embedded newline and returned entries spanning lines, which could emit uncommented lines in Varlink IDL output.

curated.title: options: reject an empty long option name
curated.note: An empty long option (--=VALUE) prefix-matched every option, and with only one defined was silently accepted as it. Now rejected.

curated.title: fix(ngram): recheck contains() with sub-trigram needle instead of dropping rows
curated.note: An NGRAM-indexed contains() with a needle under three characters returned zero rows; it now falls back to a full recheck.

curated.title: string-util: don't miss ANSI sequence at the very end in previous_ansi_sequence()
curated.note: An off-by-one skipped the last offset a two-byte escape sequence can start at, so ellipsize() over-truncated strings containing ESC M.

curated.title: ask-password: refuse agent requests with unsafe characters in prompt fields
curated.note: A newline in an ask-password prompt could inject a Socket= line and send the typed password to another path. Unsafe characters are now refused.

curated.title: ask-password: reject oversized Plymouth prompts
curated.note: Prompts of 255+ bytes wrapped Plymouth's one-byte length field, so the rest of the prompt was parsed as protocol data. Now rejected with -EMSGSIZE.

curated.title: strv: don't read past end of string on invalid UTF-8 in strv_rebreak_lines()
curated.note: A truncated multi-byte character at the end of a string made the line breaker step past the NUL terminator and read out of bounds.

curated.title: escape: reject UTF-16 surrogates in \u escapes in cunescape_one()
curated.note: \u escapes accepted UTF-16 surrogates and produced invalid UTF-8 downstream; now rejected, matching the \U form.

curated.title: hostname-util: strip all trailing separators in hostname_cleanup()
curated.note: hostname_cleanup() stripped only one trailing separator, so foobar-- came back as the invalid hostname foobar-.

curated.title: fix(python): average MRR reciprocal ranks over all rankings
curated.note: MRR fusion averaged only over the rankings a document appeared in, letting a single-system hit outrank a consensus pick.

curated.title: sysupdate: refuse reboot/pending logic when --component= is used
curated.note: sysupdate's pending and reboot compared a component's version against the host OS version, an unrelated version space, so reboot decisions were arbitrary. --component= is now refused with them. My first PR merged into systemd.

curated.title: feat(cdp): implement Browser.setDownloadBehavior file downloads
curated.note: Browser.setDownloadBehavior was a no-op, so attachment responses were rendered as pages and their bodies discarded. Downloads now stream to disk under downloadPath, with downloadWillBegin and downloadProgress events.

curated.title: fix: evaluate all list-element docs in FTS prefilter walk-the-allowlist branch
curated.note: FTS search with a where() prefilter on a list column dropped any row whose match wasn't the last element, because a row resolved to just one of its doc_ids. The prefilter walk now checks all of them.

curated.title: fix(rust): return typed errors instead of panicking in Bedrock embedding path
curated.note: The Bedrock embedding path unwrapped serialization, API and JSON-parsing results and assumed a multi-threaded Tokio runtime, so bad input panicked. Each failure now returns a typed error.

curated.title: fix(python): raise clear TypeError for bare List/Tuple in pydantic schema conversion
curated.note: A bare List or Tuple field crashed to_arrow_schema with an opaque AttributeError: __args__. It now raises a clear TypeError, like other unsupported types.

curated.title: feat(proxy): serve Anthropic-native /v1/models for Claude Code gateway discovery
curated.note: Claude Code's /model picker came up empty behind a litellm gateway, because it only parses Anthropic's Models API shape. /v1/models now returns that shape when the anthropic-version header is sent, and the OpenAI shape otherwise.

curated.title: fix(openai): preserve cache_control for openai-compatible custom endpoints
curated.note: OpenAI-compatible custom endpoints silently lost cache_control in the SDK transform, so Anthropic prompt caching behind a litellm proxy never engaged. It is now preserved.

curated.title: feat(proxy): surface max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens on /v1/models
curated.note: /v1/models gave clients no context limits, so they hardcoded them or scraped /model/info. It now includes max_input_tokens and max_output_tokens wherever the router knows them.

curated.title: fix: merge_insert silently drops matches when a leading payload column is all-null
curated.note: Critical fix: merge_insert silently dropped matched rows when the leading payload column was all-null.

curated.title: fix(proxy): release max_parallel_requests slot when a stream is cancelled mid-flight (#27955)
curated.note: Stopped a cancelled stream from stranding its max_parallel_requests slot, which had been pinning capped keys at their limit.

curated.title: feat(proxy): add disable_budget_reservation general setting (#27639)
curated.note: Phantom budget reservations on multi-replica Redis setups caused intermittent 429s for keys well under budget. Added a general setting, disable_budget_reservation, to turn the reservation off.

curated.title: fix(python): run AsyncTable.search embeddings on a dedicated executor
curated.note: AsyncTable.search ran query embeddings on asyncio's shared default thread pool, so one slow embedding call starved unrelated async I/O. They now run on a dedicated executor that is reset after fork.

curated.title: Implement input type=file support (FileList, input.files/value, DOM.setFileInputFiles)
curated.note: Real input type=file support: FileList, input.files and the fakepath value, plus CDP DOM.setFileInputFiles to load files from disk and fire input and change, the upload entry point for automation.

curated.title: feat(rust): support datafusion expressions for merge insert predicates
curated.note: The Rust merge-insert builder now takes DataFusion expressions directly (when_matched_update_all_expr, when_not_matched_by_source_delete_expr), skipping the SQL-string round trip. Remote tables return NotSupported.

curated.title: fix(proxy): don't enforce budgets on model-discovery / info routes (#27923)
curated.note: An exhausted budget returned 429 on GET /v1/models, hiding every model from clients such as Cursor and Open WebUI at startup. Model-discovery and info routes now skip the budget checks.

curated.title: gh-150311: Fix minor issues in configure.ac for the CYGWIN port
curated.note: Three Cygwin fixes in configure.ac: the system name was set to Cygwin while every case matched CYGWIN*, static builds named their library as a DLL import library (.dll.a), and the shared link hardcoded gcc and g++ instead of the configured compiler.

curated.title: feat(rust): support datafusion expressions for merge insert predicates
curated.note: Merge-insert's conditional-update predicate only took SQL strings, parsed at plan time. Added WhenMatched::UpdateIfExpr so callers can hand the planner a DataFusion Expr directly.

curated.title: feat(webapi): implement W3C File API
curated.note: Implemented the File class in Zig, a Blob subclass with a constructor, name and lastModified. lastModified is kept as a double so JavaScript doesn't see a bigint.
